en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a calm harbor or canal with several sailing ships and a steam boat. A long narrow wooden pier or breakwater extends into the water. In the background are warehouse-like brick buildings with red roofs and other small structures along the waterfront. The title 'Rendsburg a. d. Eider.' is printed in red at the bottom, and a vertical imprint of the publisher appears along the left edge.
